summary: Assertion-failure handler on the AI subsystem path. It performs a longjmp to the setjmp state supplied by the caller, passing state value 1, then invokes an unconditional debug break as a fallback. The function is noreturn.

operations.description: Call LongjmpMSVCCRT with the caller-supplied setjmp environment (a1) and state value 1 to unwind back to the matching setjmp point.
Invoke __debugbreak() as the fallback after the longjmp call returns (longjmp is normally noreturn).
No normal return path exists; the function is declared noreturn.

unresolved: What a1 points to (the setjmp environment or context) is not established; it is only forwarded to LongjmpMSVCCRT.
